usage: The word '環境' (waan4 ging2) is a noun referring to the surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
'環境' can be used to talk about natural, social, or physical settings.
It often appears with adjectives to describe the quality of the environment, like '好環境' (good environment) or '污染環境' (polluted environment).
You can use '保護環境' (protect the environment) as a common phrase to discuss environmental conservation.
'改善環境' means 'to improve the environment' and is frequently used when talking about ecological efforts.
